scenes.head: The VALDA window
scenes.say: How it's made. Episode one: the VALDA window.

scenes.head: Two factories in Bulgaria
scenes.say: VALDA has made windows and doors since 1998. Today, in two factories: Sofia, and Veliko Tarnovo.

scenes.head: Every order is drawn first
scenes.say: Every order starts on screen. Our design and engineering team draws each window before anything is cut.

scenes.head: PVC or aluminum, cut to size
scenes.say: Then the profiles, P V C or aluminum, are cut to size, on machines from the world's leading makers.

scenes.head: A fully automatic glass line
scenes.say: The insulated glass is built on our fully automatic LISEC glass line.

scenes.head: Frame, glass, hardware
scenes.say: Frame, glass and hardware come together into one finished window.

scenes.head: Packed and shipped
scenes.say: Then it's packed, loaded, and shipped, to 350 distributors across Europe and the USA.

scenes.head: The glass
scenes.say: VALDA. European windows, made to measure. Follow for episode two: the glass.
